_about: National federal voting-intention polls with fieldwork ending 2004-10-10 to 2025-05-02: house, method era, fieldwork, publication date where known, raw and effective sample, base (D decided only, D+L decided plus leaners, A undecided kept in the base, F forced choice), printed undecided, primaries (oth = all others incl. independents; onp null where not printed apart). Assembled 2026-11-23 from Simon Jackman’s public poll files (github.com/simonjackman), the ABC’s 2022 file, Wikipedia’s opinion-polling tables, The Poll Bludger’s BludgerTrack feed and the site’s own house files; reconciled on house and fieldwork. Read by .build/build-group-history.mjs.
